audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart marks every stage 'Skill' while the content layer win[0..6] reads Karma/Karma/Karma/Karma/Galio/Galio/Galio. The page renders two different answers to who wins each stage.
audit.why: Karma's Inner Flame is 950 range against Galio's 825 Q and 650 E, and Mantra is available at level 1 without a skill point, so she owns levels 1-5 outright. Hero's Entrance (4000 range at rank 1) is the first tool that makes her range irrelevant.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side = Karma, phases[4..6].side = Galio, ratings lowered early and raised late to match. Content win[] is already correct and needed no edit.
sources: kit: Karma Q range 950; Galio Q 825, E 650, R 4000/4750/5500

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text credits Focused Resolve with controlling the gap; Focused Resolve is 675 range and cannot zone Galio. Inner Flame at 950 is what holds him out.
audit.why: Kit ranges: W 675, Q 950. The spike text named the wrong ability for the zone.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[1].text around the 950-range Inner Flame gap and Shield of Durand soaking Mantra-Q.
sources: kit: Karma W range 675, Q range 950

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page states the decisive interaction: Focused Resolve only roots if the tether survives its duration, and Galio's Justice Punch (E, 650 range, 11/10/9/8/7) is his one tool for breaking it — while Shield of Durand's charge slows him, so charging W under the tether guarantees the root.
audit.why: Riot's own W text: 'If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted.' Galio's W text: 'charges a defensive stance, moving slowly.' The two together decide every commit in this lane.
audit.corrected: Stated across tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns, with the flat 12s W cooldown as the commit window.
sources: kit: Karma W cd 12 flat, range 675, text
kit: Galio W text (moves slowly), E dash 650

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that carries real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Focused Resolve flat 12s at every rank / 675 range; Inner Flame 9s down to 5s at rank 5; Mantra 40/38/36/34 and refunded by Gathering Fire on damaging abilities.
sources: kit: Karma W cd 12, Q cd 9/8/7/6/5, R cd 40/38/36/34, passive Gathering Fire

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing mentioned Grievous Wounds despite Mantra-W healing Karma while it roots.
audit.why: Riot W text: 'Mantra Bonus: Karma strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration.' Chip trading into that heal is a losing pattern.
sources: kit: Karma W Mantra bonus text

audit.whatIsWrong: packet flagged 'Your Hero's Entrance' in spikes[1] as a probable wrong ability name.
audit.why: Hero's Entrance is Galio's real R name. False positive — no name correction was made on that basis.
